title: Sonny White's Casimir-effect chip

tellings.quote:
Yeah, you have Sunny
White with who can engineer the Casemir
effect

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that an engineer named Sonny White can engineer the Casimir effect, a tiny force between objects placed very close together that is said to come from the energy of empty space. Michels mentions it as an example of people building with physics that, if it works as described, could point toward the kind of technology some link to UFOs.
